propositions: sign-review (resign_plan_review) aborts terminally when its baseline generation.collect() hits a transient store-read-failure from a concurrent writer's staged index, despite sign_manifest already having retry logic for the same race

resign's pre-signing baseline collect is wrapped in a broad except that returns a one-shot terminal refusal, whereas sign_manifest was fixed (change 2118) to retry PlanRelationSnapshotError with reason store-read-failure bounded by MAX_GENERATION_ATTEMPTS and backoff

the retry pattern from sign_manifest (bounded attempts, jittered backoff, transient classification, structured retry-after-repair refusal) must be mirrored in resign's baseline collect helper to unblock sign-review under concurrent write races
deterministic PlanRelationSnapshotError reasons (missing/ambiguous/malformed/reducer/id-mismatch) must remain terminal on first attempt without retry

unit tests must validate transient store-read-failure retries then signs, persistent failure exhausts budget into structured retry-after-repair refusal, and deterministic errors refuse on first attempt
